content.text: can you give me the mail of the admin, can you also find me an agent account that uses usd as their currency
I'll help you find both of those. Let me pull up the manuals to get the right functions for looking up admin emails and filtering agents by currency.{{READ:account_lookup}}

I can see the account_lookup function can help with both requests. I need to make two separate calls since I can only make one function call at a time. Let me start with finding an admin's email.

I need to find an admin account and get their email. Since the user asked for "the admin" (singular), I'll look for admin accounts and return the email field.{{TOOL:account_lookup}}
Great, I found the admin. Now let me get an agent account that uses USD as their currency.{{TOOL:account_lookup}}
It seems there are no agents with USD currency in the system. Let me check what currencies are available for agents by doing a broader search.{{TOOL:account_lookup}}
